response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including embedded systems and real-time applications. However, his primary expertise lies in Node.js, JavaScript, and D, with limited recent C++ experience and no clear exposure to industrial automation or the specific security standards (IEC 62443) required for this role. His background in web and desktop development does not align closely with the core responsibilities of architecting high-performance, secure, on-premises, and cloud-based C++ solutions for industrial automation.
strengths: Strong problem-solving and technical expertise across diverse domains (embedded, real-time systems, web, and mobile).
Experience with secure development practices and agile methodologies (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development).
Proven ability to optimize and scale applications, demonstrated by contributions to high-throughput systems.
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience and no clear evidence of deep STL or object-oriented design expertise required for this role.
No direct experience with industrial automation, IoT protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, etc.), or cloud platforms (Azure) mentioned in the resume.
Lack of demonstrated knowledge or application of IEC 62443-4-1 secure development lifecycle standards.
